title: agent-crew progressive-learning candidate
description: A learning-candidate record produced by the Progressive Agent Learning Loop (see core/rules/progressive-learning.md). Records a session/project/global candidate that the analyst and planner may consume as an advisory hint only. A candidate never bypasses TDD, the reviewer stage, or the quality loop.

candidate_id.description: Stable identifier for the candidate. Should be human-readable (e.g. 'ctx-break-spacing-2026-06') so that it can be referenced from review logs and analysis notes.

source.description: Where the candidate originated. reviewer_finding = a NEEDS_CHANGES finding promoted into a candidate. aar_memo = a project-layer After-Action Review memo (see memory-governance.md). user_feedback = an explicit user-stated preference or correction.

memory_layer.description: Maturity level. session = one task's observation. project = repeated, reviewer-approved project convention. global_candidate = awaiting cross-project evidence before promotion to 'global'.

evidence_refs.description: Paths (file:line or task-id artifact paths) that ground the candidate. A candidate with zero evidence_refs is invalid — every claim must be traceable.

promotion_reason.description: Human-readable justification for the candidate's existence and its current maturity level. Should describe what observation it captures and why it deserves recall.

trust_boundary.description: Machine-enforced statement that the candidate is advisory input only. A candidate cannot become policy until it has been promoted into a managed rule file under core/rules/. This field must be the literal string 'advisory_until_rule_promotion'.

promoted_from.description: Optional. The candidate_id of the lower-maturity candidate that was promoted into this one.

superseded_by.description: Optional. The candidate_id of a newer canonical candidate that has replaced this one. Presence of this field implies the candidate is in the eviction queue.

captured_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp of when the candidate was first recorded. Useful for lifecycle audits but not required — the loop is content-deterministic.

proposal_type.description: Optional approval-gated proposal action. Proposal records are advisory and do not write assets or pipeline needs_creation.

status.description: Optional lifecycle status for approval-gated proposal records.

target_asset.description: Optional proposed target asset or existing asset patch target.

target_skill.description: Optional existing skill filename targeted by an approved patch_existing_skill proposal. Used only by the approval-gated proposal apply step.

target_assets.description: Optional proposed target assets for review-principle or multi-skill proposals.

review_principle.description: Optional reusable review principle proposed for an existing skill patch.

patch_body.description: Optional approved patch body to append to target_skill. Must be present only after operator approval; proposal aggregation preserves it but does not generate or apply it.

decision_reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for the current proposal decision.

approved_by.description: Optional actor identifier for the operator or supervisor approval.

approved_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp for proposal approval.

rejected_reason.description: Optional human-readable reason why the proposal was rejected.

occurrence_count.description: Optional number of independent reports that support this proposal.

approval_gate.description: Optional explicit gate proving this proposal cannot auto-create or auto-register assets.

guardrail.description: Optional guardrail proving the proposal aggregator must not populate pipeline.needs_creation.
